details: Independent review found recent_messages verifies account scope, then fetches the conversation with ambient same-origin credentials and no explicit Bearer token or chatgpt-account-id header. Unlike list_conversations, it does not bind the provider request to the exact session token/account whose scope was verified; account/profile changes can invalidate the scope isolation assumption. Use one captured session's account+accessToken for hashing and the request headers, as in list.
